quests.name: Grown-up Things
objectives:
Dress up in grown-up clothing :
  ‧ Elegant. Black. Professional.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about your grown-up outfit.

Remove the corrupted Honey Swirls in Drowsybloom Acre to find toys:
  ‧ Beach Toys.
  ‧ Toy Car.
Chase the Toy Butterfly in Drowsybloom Acre .
Craft any Honeyglow Flower Pot .

Decorate Drowsybloom Acre using:
  ‧ Any fences. (12)
  ‧ Any paths. (12)
  ‧ Any Honeyglow Flower Pot.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about your grown-up work so far.
Remove the corrupted Honey Swirl inside Pooh's House to find another toy.
Put the toys back on their shelves. (4)
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about the thing stuck under the bed.
Use a driftwood stick to reach the chest stuck under the bed in Pooh's House .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about the locked chest that was inside Pooh's House .
Pick up the Toy Butterfly .
Bring the Toy Butterfly to Winnie the Pooh .
Follow the Toy Butterfly through Drowsybloom Acre .
Pick up the Butterfly Key in Drowsybloom Acre .
Unlock the chest inside Winnie the Pooh's House using the Butterfly Key .
Find out what was in the chest in your Inventory.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about your toy-filled adventure.

quests.name: The Backwards Day
objectives:
Get ready for bed by dressing up :
  ‧ Calm clothing. (2)
  ‧ Delicate clothing. (2)
Talk to Pooh about getting ready for bed.
Cook Warm Milk & Honey for Winnie the Pooh and you to enjoy. (2)
Go inside Winnie the Pooh's House to continue his bedtime routine.
Make sure you have the Warm Milk & Honey in your Inventory.
Bring Winnie the Pooh his Warm Milk & Honey .
Drink your Warm Milk & Honey .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about what to do next.
Craft a Honeyglow Flower Elixir .
Use the Honeyglow Flower Elixir in your Inventory.
Water flowers to make them glow. (5)
Talk to Eeyore about what he did yesterday.
Plant Golden Pattypan seeds. (3)
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about what other outdoor things he did yesterday.
Decorate Drowsybloom Acre with leaves . (5)
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about what to do next.
Go fishing for a Plush Fish .

Make sure the Plush Fish is in your Inventory.
  ‧ Show Winnie the Pooh the Plush Fish you caught. (1)
Show Winnie the Pooh the Plush Fish you caught.
Go inside Winnie the Pooh's House.
Say good morning to Winnie the Pooh to end your backwards day.

quests.name: Pooh's Grown-Up Job
objectives:
Collect items to practice a-counting:
  ‧ A precious stone that shines like honey. (1) A fallen branch that learned how to swim. (5) A round stone soft enough to carve. (12)
Sort rocks and sticks into their proper places in Pooh's House .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about his dislike for the accounting and what he wants to cook.

Collect the Ingredients needed for Pooh's Honey Garden Pie :
  ‧ Any grain. Pooh's Golden Honey. Pooh's Golden Honey. Golden Pattypan. Parsnip. Carrot.
Go inside Remy's Restaurant with Winnie the Pooh .
Cook Pooh's Honey Garden Pie .
Make sure you have Pooh's Honey Garden Pie in your Inventory.
Bring your culinary creation to Remy for a taste test.
Talk to Aladdin about collecting gems .

Go mining with Winnie the Pooh :
  ‧ Mine rock spots in Drowsybloom Acre. (3)
Pick up the Fossil you just mined.

Make sure you have the Fossil in your Inventory.
  ‧ Bring the Fossil to Winnie the Pooh.
Bring the Fossil to Winnie the Pooh .

Pick flowers:
  ‧ Purple Thistle.
  ‧ (2) Red Thistle.
  ‧ (2) White Thistle.
  ‧ (3) Yellow Thistle. (3)
Craft a Cheerful Bouquet using the flowers you picked. (1)
Make sure you have the Cheerful Bouquet in your Inventory.
Offer the Cheerful Bouquet to Minnie Mouse .
Play Pooh Sticks with Minnie .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about his day of grown-up jobs.

quests.name: The Honey Disaster
objectives: Talk to WALL-E about his honey problem.

Water the Honey Spills in Drowsybloom Acre and pick up anything left behind:
  ‧ White Feather with Gold Dust. (1) Watery Honey. (5)
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about the feather we found.
Go visit Scrooge McDuck inside his store .

Water the Honey Spills in the store and pick up what's left behind:
  ‧ Watery Honey. (7)
  ‧ Small Teapot. (1)
Talk to Scrooge McDuck about the honey mess.
Go inside Piglet's House.

Water the Honey Spills in Piglet's House and pick up what's left behind:
  ‧ Designer Fabric. (1)
  ‧ Watery Honey. (9)
Talk to Piglet about the honey mess.
Go visit Daisy in her House.

Water the Honey Spills in Daisy's House and pick up what's left behind:
  ‧ Pick up the Watery Honey. (11)
Talk to Daisy about the honey mess.

Craft what you need to throw a Bubble Party :
  ‧ Bubble Party Sign. (1)
  ‧ Honey Soap. (1)

Decorate Drowsybloom Acre with the Bubble Party Sign .
  ‧ Place the sign next to the riverbank, between the bridge and the Gloommeadow's entrance.
In Drowsybloom Acre , add Honey Soap to the river in the area between the bridge and the Gloommeadow 's entrance.
Have a Bubble Party with your friends!
Talk with Winnie the Pooh about the cleanup you did.

quests.name: The New Expedition
objectives: Talk to Winnie the Pooh about what's happening in his House.
Investigate Pooh's House for a possible ghost.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about his totally not-a-ghost guest.

Cook some meals for the expedition:
  ‧ Meals from Wishblossom Ranch. (2) Meals from the Honeyglow Woods. (2)

Make sure you have the cooked meals in your Inventory:
  ‧ Meals from Wishblossom Ranch. (2) Meals from the Honeyglow Woods. (2)
Bring the cooked meals to Winnie the Pooh .
Interact with the bridge in the Gloommeadow to play Pooh Sticks .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about what's next.
Fish out the mysterious item from the river near the bridge.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about the Orange Dye .
Follow Tigger as he leads the expedition to the Castle in the Field .
Talk to Tigger about how the expedition is going.
Follow Winnie the Pooh as he now leads the expedition to the Castle in the Field .
Hmm, there seems to be a Large Piece of Fabric here. Dig it out of the ground.

Make sure you have the expedition items in your Inventory:
  ‧ Orange Dye. Helium Tank. Large Pieces of Fabric.
Show the items found during the expedition to Winnie the Pooh .
Craft the Toadstool Bouncy Castle .
Place the Toadstool Bouncy Castle anywhere in the Honeyglow Woods .
Celebrate with Winnie the Pooh and friends!
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about the successful expedition.
